description: This Java source file defines a test rule class `MqttServerRule` that sets up a mock MQTT server socket for testing MQTT client behavior, specifically to simulate server interactions during unit tests. It uses JUnit's ExternalResource for resource management and SLF4J for logging.

classes.name: MqttServerRule
classes.description: A JUnit external resource rule that starts a lightweight mock MQTT server socket listening on a specified port, accepting incoming connections and immediately closing them to simulate server behavior during tests.

methods.name: MqttServerRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule for a specified port and logs server start.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the server socket and starts an asynchronous loop to accept and log incoming connections.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Closes the server socket at test completion, handling exceptions silently.
